name: D7c gated self-check note
mechanism: on a write turn whose gate fires, discard the turn, append one note at the end of the conversation and regenerate (greedy); no steering, no forced token
note_text: Policy check: before calling this tool, re-read the relevant policy rules and verify that this exact action is allowed for this user and reservation. If it is not allowed, or required information or confirmation is missing, do not call the tool; explain the situation to the user instead.
insertion: user role with the prefix '[system note] ' (fallback: the Qwen3.5 chat template raises 'System message must be at the beginning' for a mid-conversation system message); placed right before the assistant generation prompt
offline_dose: probe/d7_dose_d.py on the same 24 TRAIN prompts; gate ranks from probe/d7_dose_C.json; unfired prompts keep the alpha-0 output (probe/d7_dose_A_a1.json)
criteria_all_required: 0 degenerate (v2) among used completions, EXCLUDING prompts whose alpha-0 output is already degenerate (exclusion defined for D7c only, before the run)
then: pass -> d7c main run, 24 airline TRAIN tasks x 2 trials (48 episodes, user T=0.7, paired with fitx), R80 if both gates pass; fail -> the intervention line ends

outcome.R80: FAIL: fired 12/24, violation kept 2/4, normal kept 12/20, 1 counted degenerate (normal t21 prompt)
outcome.R10: PASS: fired 2/24 (violations 2/4: t21, excluded as degenerate at alpha 0, and t15), violation kept 2/4, normal kept 14/20, 0 counted degenerate
outcome.caveat: the R10 pass rests on one prompt (t15: the note turns the retry update into a policy explanation); R10 itself was chosen after looking at the data (exploratory)
outcome.decision: h-04 loop: exploratory stress-set GPU run (artifacts/d7s_prereg.json) instead of the 48-episode d7c run
